text: What if you swallowed a single drop of lava?
12× hotter than boiling water, and thick like honey.
The instant it touches your wet tongue,
For a split second, the drop skates on boiling vapor,
searing a white track across your taste buds.
Inhaling superheated steam swells your airway shut,
As you swallow, sticky molten rock clings to your esophagus,
burning a deep crater into the wall.
Hollywood shows lava melting right through your stomach —
yet 1 small drop holds only 1,000 joules of heat.
That boils less than 0.5 g of water,
so stomach acid quenches it in 3s into volcanic glass.
One drop will not melt through your belly.
Steam, a burned throat & sharp obsidian are the real danger.
